p.d: A funny portrait of a confused New York teenager and his eccentric, dysfunctional family. His staunch non-conformism leads him to make some mistakes that are hard to undo.

When Patrizia Reggiani, an outsider from humble beginnings, marries into the Gucci family, her unbridled ambition begins to unravel their legacy and triggers a reckless spiral of betrayal, decadence, revenge, and ultimately...murder.
A reformed getaway driver is thrust back into the criminal underworld to rescue her indebted ex-boyfriend, risking everything in a perilous casino heist orchestrated by a ruthless kingpin.
